thread_text:
hina: heads-up: spotted a header mismatch in SDK 3.10.0-canary that breaks model routing for embed-only requests. proposing a scoped SDK pin for the embed service during the 23:00 UTC change window.

omar: can you paste the offending request/response?

hina: snippet from canary logs:
```
2026-04-05T22:14:02Z WARN router: unexpected header 'X-Client-Model' instead of 'X-Model'
request_id: r-9a8b7c
sdk: sdk:3.10.0-canary
runtime: 3.6.2
route: /v1/embeddings
```

rui: that header name swap means the routing middleware falls through to default model which is text-gen => higher cost and wrong shape. only affects embed routes.

pm-liz: we have a few Dedicated customers on embed-heavy workloads in ap-south. customer-impact risk: medium. recommend pin until next SDK patch.

hina: plan: deploybot pin add --id sb-2104 --sdk "sdk:3.9.7" --scope "service:embeddings" --duration 4h --meta "reason:header-compat-3.10-canary" at 2026-04-05T23:00:00Z. monitor embed-error-rate and route-mismatch-count. rollback if route-mismatch >0.2% over 15m.

omar: agree. use scoped SDK pin rather than runtime pin to avoid touching gen traffic. pls ensure relnotes mention dedicated customers.

deploybot: scheduled action sb-2104 by hina for 2026-04-05T23:00:00Z.

deploybot: executed sb-2104 at 2026-04-05T23:00:03Z  sdk pinned sdk:3.9.7 to scope:service:embeddings (sb-2104).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=route-mismatch-count(service=embeddings) > 0.2% over 15m -> page @oncall-eng-sre.

hina: initial telemetry looks good; route-mismatch dropped to baseline. keeping 30m watch.

omar: note: ops can remove pin with `deploybot pin remove --id sb-2104` once stable. also add a short-lived feature-flag rollback hook in case of unexpected fallout.

pm-liz: customer comms drafted and reviewed; will send if we extend pin beyond 4h.

hina: after 3.5h stable we plan to lift at 03:00 UTC unless PMs request extension.

deploybot: remove request queued for sb-2104 at 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z.

deploybot: executed removal of sb-2104 at 2026-04-06T03:00:07Z  pin removed.

srebot: sb-2104 lifecycle: created -> active -> removed. no pager events.

omar: relnotes updated: "Scoped SDK pin (3.9.7) for embeddings service during 3.10.0 canary to mitigate header compatibility change; no customer-visible incidents."

hina: closing thread. thanks all :raised_hands:
